title: Cofibrant inclusion gives an equivalence of coherent localizations
statement:
Use model categories, weak equivalences, cofibrant objects and functorial factorizations as in [lem-coef-model-infinity-derived-adjunction], and homotopy coherent localization with its full functor-category universal property as in [lem-coef-system-localization-universal]. Enlarge universes to contain the nerves and localizations below. Let $\mathcal M$ be a model category, let $\mathcal M^c$ be its full ordinary subcategory of cofibrant objects, and give this subcategory the weak equivalences $W^c$ inherited from the weak equivalences $W$ of $\mathcal M$. Let $j:\mathcal M^c\to\mathcal M$ be inclusion. A functorial factorization of the initial maps as cofibrations followed by trivial fibrations gives $Q:\mathcal M\to\mathcal M^c$ and a natural trivial fibration $\epsilon:jQ\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal M}$. Then $Q$ preserves weak equivalences, and the induced functors
$$j_\infty:N(\mathcal M^c)[(W^c)^{-1}]\rightleftarrows N(\mathcal M)[W^{-1}]:Q_\infty$$
are inverse equivalences. The natural transformations induced by $\epsilon$ and its restriction to $\mathcal M^c$ give equivalences $j_\infty Q_\infty\simeq\mathrm{id}$ and $Q_\infty j_\infty\simeq\mathrm{id}$ in the corresponding coherent functor categories. In particular these comparisons are natural on coherent diagrams and their transformations, rather than only on homotopy categories.
